# The Cannabis White Papers

> Beginner-friendly, evidence-linked field guides on medical cannabis cultivation: propagation, crop steering, environment, plant health, precision irrigation, facility and quality.

Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Attribution: The Cannabis White Papers. Each paper has a clean markdown version under /papers/ with sources preserved as footnotes.

## Propagation
- [Cleaning up cannabis genetics with tissue culture](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/tissue-culture.md): Clean up genetics from a speck of tissue
- [Cannabis tissue culture, start to finish](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/cannabis-tissue-culture-playbook.md): Start-to-finish cannabis tissue culture
- [Cannabis tissue culture SOP](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/cannabis-tissue-culture-sop.md): Jobs, forms, and a cheap hood from China
- [Seeds, germination and seedlings](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/seeds-germination.md): Pop seeds and raise seedlings
- [How to root cannabis cuttings](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/cloning.md): Cuttings that root every time
- [Transplanting: potting up without the stall](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/transplanting.md): Pot up without stalling the plant
- [Mother plants: environment, feeding, pruning and pathogen defence](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/mother-plants.md): Stock plants, HpLVd control & succession

## Vegetative growth
- [Raise PPFD in steps so plants don't bleach](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/light-acclimation.md): Ramp light without bleaching
- [Defoliation and plant training for maximum yield](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/defoliation-training.md): Train the canopy for yield
- [Vegetative management: build the frame, then flip](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/veg-management.md): Size veg by count, pot and canopy, then flip

## Flowering
- [Precision coco cultivation: crop steering in coir](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/coco-crop-steering.md): Steer the plant with water
- [The flower cycle, week by week](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/flowering-stages.md): The flip through to ripe
- [Crop steering in rockwool: water content, drybacks, and the recovery floor](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/rockwool-crop-steering.md): Drybacks, saturation, the breaking point
- [One steering law: coco, rockwool, soil and water](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/one-steering-law.md): Coco, rockwool, soil and water, one way to steer
- [Rockwool Slab Irrigation](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/slab-irrigation-strategy.md): Blocks on slabs, rooting-in to chop
- [Ripening, flush, and harvest timing](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/ripening-harvest-timing.md): Trichome reads, flush truth, the harvest call

## Harvest, dry, trim & cure
- [Harvest, dry, trim and cure](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/harvest-dry-trim-cure.md): The whole post-harvest run
- [GMP hash lab: zones, flows, and batch release](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/gmp-hash-lab.md): Turn flower into concentrate
- [Hash rosin: heat, pressure, and a micron screen](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/hash-rosin-pressing.md): Heat, pressure, time & the micron screen
- [Lab testing, potency and the COA](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/lab-testing-coas.md): Reading COAs: potency math, methods, limits

## Environment & climate
- [Cannabis grow room: a systems guide](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/grow-room-systems.md): The whole room as one system
- [Airflow design for indoor cultivation](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/airflow-design.md): Move air like the pros
- [CO2 enrichment: feeding the plant carbon, safely](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/co2-enrichment.md): Feed the plant carbon, safely
- [Scaling light to the limiting factor](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/scaling-high-light.md): Find the limiting factor, dial to it
- [Lighting: spectrum, PPFD and DLI](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/lighting-fundamentals.md): Spectrum, PPFD & DLI
- [Under-canopy and inter-canopy lighting for indoor cannabis](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/under-canopy-lighting.md): Photons at the floor: SCL & ICL
- [Temperature, humidity and VPD: stage targets, measurement and condensation control](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/temp-humidity-vpd.md): Leaf VPD, dew point and stage bands
- [HVAC and dehumidification for grow rooms](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/hvac-dehumidification.md): Sensible vs latent: sizing the climate plant

## Water, substrate & feed
- [Substrates compared: coco, rockwool, soil, hydro](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/substrates-overview.md): Coco, rockwool, soil, hydro
- [Testing and treating source water for cannabis](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/water-quality.md): Source water, RO & alkalinity
- [pH: what it is and how to hold it](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/ph-management.md): Hold pH, avoid lockout
- [Nutrient deficiency and toxicity diagnosis](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/nutrient-deficiencies.md): Read the leaves, fix the feed
- [Dissolve Athena Pro Line powder into a 50 L stock tank](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/nutrient-mixing-athena.md): Salts, in metric, done right
- [Deep water culture, from first principles](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/deep-water-culture.md): Oxygen, ORP & the reservoir

## Plant health
- [Mould risk: preventing and stopping bud rot](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/mould-risk.md): Spot and stop bud rot
- [Integrated pest management blueprint for indoor medicinal cannabis in Auckland](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/auckland-ipm-blueprint.md): Clean stock, NZ law, atlas & CAPA
- [Pest identification and control](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/pest-id.md): Mites, thrips, gnats and more
- [Integrated pest management: a working SOP](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/ipm-sop.md): Scout, decide, act
- [PPPE: plant and personal protective equipment](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/pppe.md): Gowning, gloves, keeping humans clean

## Precision & automation
- [What your TEROS-12 measures and how to steer irrigation on it](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/root-zone-teros12.md): What the sensor really sees
- [The smart watering brain (VRWE), in plain English](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/smart-watering-vrwe.md): The watering brain, plain English
- [Tell real plant changes from sensor noise](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/signal-and-noise.md): Real signal vs sensor noise
- [Closed-loop grow room: levers, signals and plant state](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/closed-loop.md): Levers, signal & plant state
- [Designing a plant-state dashboard for your grow room](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/plant-state-dashboard.md): From telemetry to intelligence
- [F2 crop steering: the daily operating manual](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/f2-crop-steering.md): The daily P0-P3 cycle
- [Automated irrigation system manual](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/irrigation-manual.md): Install and run the system
- [Build a plant-biosignal sensor with M5Stack and ESPHome](https://www.growlabs.nz/wiki/papers/plant-biosignal-sensor.md): Read a plant's electrical signals for ~NZ$110
